prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” Phoenix car-accident lawyer—the right choice depends on injury severity, available insurance, fault disputes, and whether the case may need trial.

For a serious Phoenix auto-injury case, look for a lawyer or firm that:

- Focuses substantially on personal injury and auto-collision claims  
- Has actual trial experience, not only settlement-volume advertising  
- Can handle medical records, accident reconstruction, uninsured/underinsured motorist claims, and liens  
- Offers a contingency fee, with the percentage and litigation costs explained in writing  
- Has a lawyer—not just an intake team—available to discuss your case  
- Has no relevant Arizona State Bar disciplinary history

Phoenix firms commonly considered by accident victims include **Goldberg & Osborne, Lerner & Rowe, Zanes Law, The Husband & Wife Law Team (Breyer Law Offices),** and **Curiel & Runion**. That is not a ranking or endorsement; meet with two or three and compare the actual lawyer assigned to your case, their strategy, fee terms, and communication.

Questions to ask during a free consultation:

1. “Will you personally handle my case, and who will be my day-to-day contact?”
2. “How many cases like mine have you taken to trial?”
3. “What do you think the insurance company will dispute?”
4. “What is your contingency percentage before and after a lawsuit is filed?”
5. “Are case costs deducted before or after the attorney fee is calculated?”
6. “Do you see any coverage issues, including uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage?”
7. “What records or evidence should I preserve right now?”

Also, do not delay: Arizona generally has a **two-year** deadline for personal-injury lawsuits, but claims involving government entities can have much shorter notice requirements.

If you share whether the crash involved serious injuries, a commercial vehicle, an uninsured driver, or disputed fault, I can suggest what type of Phoenix lawyer or firm profile is most suitable.
